name: Fuka Izumi
bio: Fuka Izumi (和泉 風花, Izumi Fūka, January 11) is a Japanese voice actress from Aichi Prefecture. She is affiliated with Amuse. She was formerly affiliated with Vims. She graduated from Nihon Narration Engi Kenkyūjo (training school for seiyūs). On August 31, 2022, she left Vims, the agency she had belonged to since her debut, and she joined Amuse on October 5 of the same year after a freelance period. Her hobbies include watching stage performances and reading; her special skills include Japanese drums and singing.
